envelope.reason: Record gathering found two different immutable payloads under one ULID path.
envelope.cause: The main checkout has an untracked design record that collides with an existing line record.

payload.title: Immutable record ID collision 01M4055WFZCMFSX97216YRCT18
payload.body: While gathering records, the main checkout held an untracked records/design/01M4055WFZCMFSX97216YRCT18.json whose content differs from the immutable record already on the integration line at that same ULID path. The line copy was preserved; the conflicting main-checkout copy was not imported or overwritten. Resolve the duplicate-ID record inconsistency before claiming that the line has gathered every record and is releasable.
